items.distractor_fact: באותו הבוקר מדד תושב משכונה סמוכה, בעזרת מד החום הפרטי שלו, טמפרטורה שעמדה על {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: That same morning, a resident from a nearby neighborhood measured, using his own private thermometer, a temperature that stood at D°C.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a person (a local resident with his own thermometer), not a place, unlike the first distractor's coastal city.

items.distractor_fact: באותו יום המסחר עמד שווי אחזקותיו הפרטיות של סוחר עצמאי אחר על {D}₪.
items.gloss_en: On that same trading day, the value of a different independent trader's private holdings stood at D₪.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a person (an independent trader), not an organisation, unlike the first distractor's different company.

items.distractor_fact: באותו החודש מדד דייג מקומי, לפי סימון פרטי משלו, מפלס מים שעמד על {D} מ'.
items.gloss_en: During that same month, a local fisherman measured, by his own private marker, a water level that stood at D m.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a person (a local fisherman with his own marker), not a place, unlike the first distractor's nearby lake.

items.distractor_fact: באותו הזמן עמד גובהה של משואת קרקע שבגבעה הסמוכה על {D} מ'.
items.gloss_en: At that same time, the height of a ground beacon on the nearby hill stood at D m.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a place (a fixed beacon on a nearby hill), not another instrument, unlike the first distractor's different drone.

items.distractor_fact: באותה עונת האימונים עמד משקלו של תיק הציוד של הקבוצה על {D} ק"ג.
items.gloss_en: During that same training season, the weight of the team's equipment bag stood at D kg.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: an instrument/object (the team's equipment bag), not a person, unlike the first distractor's different gymnast.

items.distractor_fact: באותו העשור עמד מספר החברים הרשומים בעמותה מקומית על {D} נפש.
items.gloss_en: During that same decade, the number of registered members in a local nonprofit organisation stood at D people.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: an organisation (a local nonprofit), not a place, unlike the first distractor's neighboring settlement.

items.distractor_fact: באותו הזמן עמדה מהירות הרכבים הממוצעת שנמדדה בנקודת מדידה אחרת בכביש על {D} קמ"ש.
items.gloss_en: At that same time, the average vehicle speed measured at a different measurement point on the road stood at D km/h.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a place (a different measurement point on the road), not another single vehicle, unlike the first distractor's different car.

items.distractor_fact: באותו היום עמד הסכום בקופה הקטנה במקום עבודתו של דני על {D}₪.
items.gloss_en: On that same day, the amount in the petty cash box at Danny's workplace stood at D₪.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: an organisation (Danny's workplace / its cash box), not a person, unlike the first distractor's Danny's colleague.

items.distractor_fact: באותו החודש עמדה היתרה בפיקדון חיסכון נפרד בבנק על {D}₪.
items.gloss_en: During that same month, the balance in a separate savings deposit at the bank stood at D₪.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: an impersonal financial instrument (a separate bank deposit), not a person, unlike the first distractor's Michal's colleague.

items.distractor_fact: באותו החודש עמד שכר הטרחה שגבה יועץ חיצוני שביקר בחברה על {D}₪.
items.gloss_en: That same month, the fee charged by an external consultant who visited the company stood at D₪.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a person (an external consultant), not an organisation, unlike the first distractor's competing company.

items.distractor_fact: באותה העונה עמד מספר השערים שהבקיע לבדו שחקן מקבוצה אחרת על {D}.
items.gloss_en: That same season, the number of goals scored alone by a player from a different team stood at D.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a person (an individual player), not an organisation, unlike the first distractor's rival team.

items.distractor_fact: במהלך אותה השנה עמד סך הרווחים של קרן השקעות בתיק נפרד על {D}₪.
items.gloss_en: During that same year, the total gains of an investment fund in a separate portfolio stood at D₪.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: an organisation (an investment fund), not a person, unlike the first distractor's different investor.

items.distractor_fact: באותו הטורניר עמד מספר המכות שנרשם בלוח התוצאות של מגרש גולף אחר על {D}.
items.gloss_en: In that same tournament, the number of strokes recorded on the scoreboard of a different golf course stood at D.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: a place (a different course's own scoreboard), not a person, unlike the first distractor's different golfer; that course's own par is not stated, so the story's par does not apply to it.

items.distractor_fact: במקביל עמדה הקומה שאליה הגיעה מעלית פרטית של חברה אחרת על {D}.
items.gloss_en: In parallel, the floor reached by a private elevator belonging to a different company stood at D.
items.entity_note: different owner kind: an organisation (a different company's own elevator), not a place, unlike the first distractor's nearby building; that company's own reference floor is not stated, so the story's reference floor does not apply to it.
